story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by heros and villains. Heros always tell the truth, and villains always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Riley, and Abigail. Riley expressed that if Abigail is a villain then Riley is a hero. Abigail asserted: "Abigail is a hero if and only if Riley is a villain". So who is a hero and who is a villain? (Format your answer like: "Riley is a hero/villain, and Abigail is a hero/villain")

Riley is a hero, Abigail is a hero
Riley is a villain, Abigail is a hero
